scorecard.name: Paraphrasing
scorecard.coaching: Failed to paraphrase customer's landline Caller ID presentation issue in own words.

scorecard.name: Active listening
scorecard.coaching: Asked customer at turn 42 for landline number which was already provided at turn 3.

grader.scenario: Landline Caller ID service not displaying names on Panasonic cordless phone; resolved via FSK re-provisioning
grader.notes: Good call where agent was polite, empathetic, and resolved Caller ID fault, failing only paraphrasing and active listening repeat in the final third.

items.name: Branding and Survey Check
items.evidence: Agent opened with 'Thank you for calling S-Net landline customer services' at [00:00] and closed with 'Thank you for choosing S-Net' in final lines.

items.name: Hold time and Dead Air
items.evidence: Hold was announced with could I place you on hold and thanked upon return without unmanaged dead air.

items.name: Verified customer
items.evidence: Verified full postal address and security PIN within the first 240 seconds.

items.name: Personalized the call/ticket appropriately
items.evidence: Agent addressed customer as Miriam throughout the call.

items.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
items.evidence: Agent demonstrated empathy at turn 22 ('I completely understand how deeply alarming and dangerous that is for your sister, Miriam...') and customer had no unhandled outbursts.

items.name: Paraphrasing
items.evidence: Agent never restated the Caller ID fault in own words.

items.name: Active listening
items.evidence: Agent asked for landline number at turn 42 despite customer stating 01423 881204 at turn 3.

items.name: Took ownership of the problem
items.evidence: Agent re-provisioned FSK signaling, ran automated loopback test, applied goodwill credit, and locked permanent profile flag.

items.name: Build rapport and observed professionalism
items.evidence: Agent maintained polite, supportive, and professional demeanor throughout.

items.name: Probing
items.evidence: Agent asked about line noise and handset settings.

items.name: Confirmed the issue is resolved
items.evidence: Test call from network test number and mobile call both displayed correctly on Panasonic handset screen.
